programs.title: Reba McEntire's The Hammer
programs.desc: A newly appointed judge makes sure justice is served when her sister becomes the prime suspect in the suspicious death of her courtroom predecessor.

programs.title: When I Said I Do
programs.desc: A widowed K-9 handler remains reluctant to open her heart again, until she meets a rescue specialist with a past of his own. As their connection deepens into something real and healing, they must decide whether they have the courage to choose love.

programs.title: The Man in the Window
programs.desc: Sarah feels like her life is finally getting back on track when she starts dating Jack, a handsome man who just moved in across the street. However, when a neighbor turns up dead and all signs point to Jack, she risks it all to prove he's the killer.
